plugins.name: HelloDino
plugins.author: Dino 8 Project
plugins.description: Same sample plug-in as plugin-index/index.json's hellodino entry, but with a sha256 that deliberately does not match the built library, so Marketplace::VerifyInstalled reports a mismatch against what is actually on disk (a bundled_path entry is never sha256-checked at install time, only on-demand by VerifyInstalled/PluginMarketplaceVerify - see plugin-index/SCHEMA.md).
